title: Puharich's journal records a day with Townsend Brown in DC

tellings.quote: journals, he mentions um meeting Townsend Brown >> [laughter] >> and spending the day with him.

plain: Andrija Puharich, a physician and researcher of psychic phenomena, wrote in his journals of meeting Thomas Townsend Brown, an American inventor, and spending the day with him in Washington in 1953. An unnamed guest who has read the journals mentions it on the show, to some laughter. It would link two men later known for fringe science at an early date.
